{{Quote|Be a role model for a new recruit today! Visit your local recruiting officer to sign up to be a mentor. You'll definitely get incentives for serving the Empire in this way.|Sergeant Farhope|<ref name="SWG:AN" />}}
'''Wen Farhope''' was a member of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|armed forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Farhope was a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Wen Farhope was involved in a large recruitment program of new [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] for the Imperial [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]].<ref name="SWG:AN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wen Farhope was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AN" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The document mentioning Wen Farhope was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:AN" />
